name: AI Policy Gateway
description: Governance layer that enforces policy, routing, privacy, budgets and approvals on AI calls.
project_description:
AI Policy Gateway adds a governance layer for Drupal AI calls, enforcing policy profiles, provider/model routing,

 privacy checks, budgets and approval gates before prompts leave the site.

 Features 
 This module provides centralized policy enforcement for Drupal AI. It adds policy profiles, provider/model allow‑deny

 rules, privacy inspection, redaction, budget tracking, audit logging, and optional human approval queues.

 Enable it when you need safe, compliant AI usage across Drupal AI integrations. Use cases include regulated content

 workflows, local-only AI routing, high-risk tool calls, spend control, and provider fallback policies.

 Post-Installation 
 After install, go to /admin/config/ai/policy-gateway . From there you manage gateway settings, policy

 profiles, routing rules, model metadata, approval queue and audit reports.

 There is no new content type; the module works as a control layer for Drupal AI provider requests. Configure policies

 before you enable it for active AI workflows, especially when using AI Agents or regulated content.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires Drupal 10.3+ or 11 and the ai module. The module also depends on Drupal core system, user,

 and datetime subsystems.

 Optional integrations improve behavior when related AI ecosystem modules are enabled.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Recommended enhancements include AI Observability/OpenTelemetry, AI Decision Log and AI Context Bridge for richer

 logging, decision mirroring and context-aware policy metadata.

 Use AI Agents for approval-aware tool/action workflows.

 Similar projects 
 Other Drupal AI modules typically connect providers or add AI-enabled content tools. AI Policy Gateway is different

 because it focuses on governance, safe routing, privacy/redaction, budget control and approval workflows rather than

 just provider integration.
